description: TCK-2348 — the publication notices clients translate by code (the QGIS plugin). A code, its parameters and the English message ALIGN shows. Changing a code or a parameter name breaks those clients: change them together.

notices.message: The field "photo" holds binary data and is not published.
The field "fid" is kept as "source_fid": the service numbers its features itself.
The field "GEOM" is kept as "source_geom": the service keeps the geometry in its own column.
Curved geometries are published as their linear approximation.
The Z (altitude) values of the geometries are not kept: the layer is published in 2D.
The M (measure) values of the geometries are not kept: the layer is published in 2D.
The Z (altitude) and M (measure) values of the geometries are not kept: the layer is published in 2D.
The projection of this layer is unknown: choose it before publishing.
The file was kept: you can no longer remove it.
The file was kept: another service of the same publication is built from it.
The publication finished after an interruption: the counts shown may be incomplete.
